# hypothesis: out(r,c) = tiled[r%h][c%w]; override: if r%p==c%p==0 and tiled==2 -> 8
def solve(inp,h,w,p):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0]); O=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            tv=inp[r%h][c%w]
            O[r][c]=8 if (r%p==0 and c%p==0 and tv==2) else tv
    return O

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); I=G['Demo pair 3 input']; O=G['Demo pair 3 output']
T=G['Test input']
H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # band: rows/cols that are solid 3
    brs=[i for i in range(H) if all(inp[i][j]==3 for j in range(W))]
    bcs=[j for j in range(W) if all(inp[i][j]==3 for i in range(H))]
    rmin,rmax=min(brs),max(brs); cmin,cmax=min(bcs),max(bcs)+1
    bandrows=set(range(rmin,rmax+1)); bandcols=set(range(cmin,cmax))
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if i in bandrows and j in bandcols: continue
            v=inp[i][j]
            if v==2 and i%5==0 and j%5==0: v=8
            out[i][j]=v
    for i in bandrows:
        for j in bandcols:
            si=i-rmin; sj=j-cmin
            v=inp[si][sj] if si<H and sj<W else 0
            if v==2 and i%5==0 and j%5==0: v=8
            out[i][j]=v
    return out
print('demo match:', f(I)==O)
res=f(T)
print(json.dumps(res))
